summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_048 contract. The governance-stage wrapper delegates directly to the runtime adapter, preserves the bounded 12-section report hierarchy, supports explicit inadmissible bypass, exposes appendix and demotion traceability, and surfaces congruence signals without reopening the client-facing body.

findings: The implementation accepts the documented thesis, mode-selection and congruence-claim inputs, with the wrapper enforcing mapping-shaped input before runtime delegation.

Executable coverage confirms the main compression behaviors: a bounded structural outline, compact client-facing TAD, explicit demotions and prompt-block mapping for admissible cases, plus full structural bypass for inadmissible thesis cases.
Congruence compression coverage confirms that congruence signals can be embedded into existing body sections and appendix support without reopening a second technical body.
The motor stays within boundary: it does not fabricate a stronger visible mode or expand inadmissible cases into structural body sections.

The wrapper returns the expected top-level surfaces: main_report_outline, appendix_map, section_authority_map, deduplicated_claim_map, client_facing_tad, congruence_visibility_register, section_demotions_register, body_to_appendix_justification_map, prompt_block_mapping_register and compression_decision_log.

The read-only governance-wrapper smoke check over the bridge fixture produced visible_report_mode=Compliance / Investment Screening Brief, max_primary_sections=12, section_count=12, client_facing_tad_action_count=1, congruence_visible_signal_count=8 and prompt_block_mapping_count=23.
The same smoke preserved appendix-first support with first_appendix_title=Blocking Conflicts, consistent with the bounded hierarchy expected by downstream package assembly and validation.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable conformance evidence covered bounded structural outline construction, client-facing TAD compression, appendix demotion traceability, prompt-block mapping, congruence signal embedding and inadmissible structural bypass. This is sufficient for conformance review because it exercises both the compressed admissible path and the explicit bypass path of the hierarchy engine.
